content:
maria: Ok team — Q3 runtime roadmap sync. Need to agree on a clear upgrade path for kernels + quant + KV cache so we can commit to customers (Dedicated + Private). I sketched three candidate initiatives: 1) kernel fusion track, 2) adaptive quant rollout (per-workload profiles), 3) KV cache prefetch + TTL heuristics. Which one is our highest-EQ impact for next quarter?

sam: +1. curious about customer-driven asks: which customers are blocking on perf vs cost?

maria: @sam good call — enterprise X and marketplace Y both asked for predictable 99p latency under 250ms at 8k context. X is willing to pay for dedicated capacity if we can hit it. Y wants cost improvements first.

tyler: From infra side: kernel fusion reduces per-token latency by ~15% in our sims but increases peak GPU memory by ~20%. Adaptive quant gives ~30% token-cost reduction for embeddings-heavy workloads but needs per-model calibration. KV prefetch helps tail latency on long-chats.

ev an: can we be explicit on launch criteria? propose: 1) perf regression <= 1% vs baseline; 2) canary at 10% traffic for 2 weeks with no P0 incidents; 3) telemetry hooks for token-level breakdowns exposed in Console.

sofia: Telemetry note: we need retention for at least 30 days on the new metrics for rollback analysis. Also add prompt-set diffing to catch quality regressions for quant.

maria: actionable tradeoffs: if we prioritize kernel fusion we probably push adaptive quant to Q4. If customers X/Y pay or commit, we could parallelize. Need cost model for each.

tyler: I'll run a quick cost-e2e estimate by EOD: peak GPU mem, throughput delta, and expected ops cost delta.

ev an: For launch criteria add automatic fallback: if tail latency > 350ms for 5m, route to fallback variant (non-fused kernel or higher-precision quant). That protects customers during rollouts.

sofia: Also suggest we define a small eval suite per customer (3 replay prompts) to validate quality before canary. Keeps customer-driven asks reproducible.

maria: Nice. Proposed prioritization (tentative): 1) kernel fusion MVP + canary infra, 2) KV prefetch improvements, 3) adaptive quant calibration. We accept customer-paid parallel work for quant.

sam: +1 to that ladder. Any blockers on infra quotas / Dedicated allocations?

tyler: We need two extra p4d nodes for the kernel fusion perf runs and one reserved cluster for canary. I put a request in infra.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: perf-ci/kernel-fusion-runner -> started (ci-3221). Logs: http://ci.redwood/example/3221

ev an: tomorrow's agenda: define the explicit set of metrics and thresholds we will show in Console for the launch checklist. Also we should write the rollback playbook now so SREs can rehearse it.

maria: Perfect. Next steps: tyler executes cost + infra ask, sofia drafts eval suite + retention policy, evan drafts launch checklist & rollback playbook, sam to coordinate with sales on paid parallel work. I'll collect updates in the roadmap doc and move to a formal proposal by Friday. :thumbsup:
